                                                                                                       Kıvanç ZAİMLER BOARD MEMBER & CEO
    Kıvanç Zaimler has served as CEO and board member of Sabancı Holding since June 1, 2025. Since 2018, as Head of the Sabancı Energy Group, he has chaired the boards of Enerjisa Enerji, Enerjisa Üretim and Sabancı Climate Technologies,

    Industrial Engineering graduate, Zaimler is Deputy Chair of the World Energy Council Türkiye and serves on industry and nonprofit boards.
